about: Pin escapes laid BEFORE trunk.py (phase 2 round 2, worker A): via escapes of the Port 1 charger U403 whose via sites the 5 mm PACK_P B.Cu trunk takes when it is laid first (its 2 mm neck passes under U403's south-east corner). With the vias in the plan first, the trunk routes round them. Call: pins.py --rules=table --table=plan/p2-pins-u403.json, before trunk.py.
